implementation.reason: The step-1 protocol is additive. Prepared04 data, the source lock, the v1 curve module/runner/config/tests and the v1 receipt are unchanged. The five historical read-only migrations are carried verbatim; the three new v2 accounting files are pinned at their current bytes.

migration.reason: The trainer retains shared per-row prompt/label/EOS coverage evidence; the prepared04 payload is unchanged.
Generation rows report the model-declared stop set; prompt, label, scoring and sealed-data semantics are unchanged.
Unrelated concurrent work adds PlasticSpec/PlasticRead contracts; this protocol does not use them and enforces the declared bytes.
Unrelated concurrent plastic read/site capture work is additive; projector, forward_with_frame, generation and loss paths are unchanged and enforced.
Unrelated concurrent plastic input plumbing is additive and optional; visual prepare/forward/backward/generate paths are unchanged and enforced.

limitations: One training-only step-1 reproduction; it cannot change the v1 curve_no_optimization_progress verdict and cannot authorize development, held-out, V0, promotion or retry.
Expected historical NLLs, digests and norms are hypotheses and anchors, not pass/fail gates; the only causal read is the repeated prefix-0 null readout and the first update's effect on prefix-1 loss.
No probes, prefix 2/4/7, extension/checkpoint writes, downloads or model reloads are allowed.
Native execution is refused until an external authorization receipt binds the committed config SHA-256.
The measured 5,660 decoder passes are physical calls; 882 prepares is not the scoring-forward total.
